project.name: 220 mm decorated food-serving bowl
project.notes: Fine ornament outside; smooth qualified interior; printed cases create plaster working-mold sections.

casting.body_or_product: Exact porcelain slip, glaze, decoration, and firing schedule to be locked

printer.material: PETG/PLA printed case, sealed and released only at case-plaster interface

mold.parting_strategy: Two side plaster sections plus foot section; add more side sections if exterior relief locks.

acceptance: No undercut below rim in any rigid plaster section
Complete drain without retained slip pockets
Final interior has no crazing, pinholes, crawling, shivering, or sharp defects
Representative final articles pass current applicable migration testing
Dishwasher qualification passes the declared cycle count and conditions
